_about: Built by `python -m eval.sources` from eval/reports_*.csv and eval/aliases.json; don't edit by hand. Each source is a fishing report or trip write-up and the flies it said to use. 'said' is the report's own words; 'match' is the catalog flies it stands for (a fly id, food:<id> for flies imitating that food at 0.5 or more, family:<type>; terms joined by spaces must all match, ! excludes). 'named' means the report named the pattern itself rather than a kind of fly.

picks.said: para wulffs in the bwo color
